facts.text: Passive Seismic Experiment Package was deployed at Sea of Tranquility during Apollo 11 in 1969.
Solar-powered seismometer deployed by Aldrin. Detected moonquakes, meteorite impacts, and the vibration from the ascent stage liftoff. Operated for 21 days before its power ran out.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the lunar environment.
Detected the first moonquakes ever recorded and measured seismic waves from the ascent stage liftoff, revealing that the Moon has a layered internal structure.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Sea of Tranquility.
Operated for only 21 days before its solar power system overheated and failed; its brief dataset helped design the long-lived ALSEP seismometers on later missions.
